name: nodepilot-desktop
description: NodePilot desktop shell — a thin Electron viewer for the locally-hosted NodePilot backend.
//engines: One repository-wide floor, not this project's own minimum. react-router 8 in
nodepilot-ui and nodepilot-docs-ui requires >=22.22.0; contributors build all three
from a single Node install, so publishing two different floors would just re-create
the version drift this field exists to remove.
//types-node: @types/node tracks the Node that Electron actually bundles (43.2.0 -> Node 24.18.0),
not the newest release line. Bumping it past the runtime would type-check against
APIs the shipped Electron does not have.
//overrides: Electron Forge's own dependency tree pulls three packages whose only patched
releases sit in a newer major line than the one Forge asks for, so npm cannot
resolve them on its own (`npm audit fix` proposes downgrading Forge itself).
Forge is already on its latest release, so waiting it out is not an option either.
Nothing here ships: Forge is build-time only and `dependencies` is empty.
Drop an entry once Forge's own tree moves past it.
tar             6.2.1  -> 7.x   arbitrary file write via hardlink path traversal (critical)
brace-expansion 1.x/2.x-> 5.x   DoS via unbounded expansion length (high)
tmp             0.0.33 -> 0.2.x arbitrary temp write via symlinked dir (high)
